map.I=1 → τ=4 N·m，同角加速需更大力矩。: I = 1 gives τ = 4 N·m; the same angular acceleration then needs more torque.
map.τ=Iα 对应 F=ma，I 为转动惯量、α 为角加速度。: τ = Iα mirrors F = ma, with I the moment of inertia and α the angular acceleration.
map.本式仅加速项；水平臂还需叠加重力矩。: This covers only the acceleration term; a horizontal arm also needs the gravity torque added on.
map.转动惯量与扭矩（本页代码口径）：τ=I×α（N·m，I 转动惯量 kg·m²、α: Moment of inertia and torque (this page's code basis): τ = I×α (N·m, I moment of inertia in kg·m², α angular acceleration in rad/s²); linked values: angular acceleration (°/s²) = α×180÷π, torque (kgf·m) = τ÷9.80665. Validation: no strict validation; empty values fall back to 0. Criteria: no fixed grading; torque is proportional to both inertia and angular acceleration, and motor selection must satisfy peak torque and the accel/decel time at once.
